name: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis, activation or use of the prosthetic cofactors pyridoxal phosphate and molybdenum cofactor (including the Moco-dependent sulfite oxidase step of sulfide oxidation), which separates the theme from confusables centred on amino acid, sulfur or methylglyoxal metabolism.

name: Quiescence transitions and retinoic acid receptor signaling regulation
rationale: Members regulate G0/G1 quiescence transitions and nuclear receptor (retinoic acid, estrogen) signaling during differentiation, distinguishing the theme from E2F/proliferative, thyroid-receptor and TP53-arrest confusables.

name: Erythrocyte Rhesus complex and oxygen-carbon dioxide exchange
rationale: Members cover red cell Rh/RHAG membrane complex biosynthesis and erythrocyte gas (O2, CO2, NO) transport, whereas the confusables centre on Rh glycoprotein ammonium transport.

name: Noncanonical and lymphocyte receptor-driven NF-kB activation
rationale: Members describe NIK-dependent noncanonical NF-kB and NF-kB activation downstream of TCR, CD40, CD27 and BCR (with IKK-complex deficiencies), distinguishing it from TLR/TNFR1/NOD innate NF-kB confusables and from lymphocyte-biology confusables lacking NF-kB.

qualifier: stress granule and PML body dynamics
name: Proteasomal turnover and stress granule/PML body dynamics
rationale: Members regulate ubiquitin-proteasome protein degradation together with stress granule and PML body assembly under arsenite/PKR stress, the latter being absent from the protein quality control confusables.

name: Vitamin C metabolism and antioxidant vitamin response
rationale: Members cover ascorbate/dehydroascorbate metabolism, transport and responses to vitamins C and E (hepatic stellate activation being an ascorbate-sensitive context), unlike confusables focused on ROS detoxification, collagen, thyroid or iron.

name: Immediate-early genes induced by growth factors and TNF
rationale: The three gene sets share the immediate-early transcriptional program (NR4A, FOS/JUN, EGR, growth arrest genes) induced by growth factors and TNF, distinct from UV-response, senescence, MAPK-phosphatase and myeloid inflammation confusables.

qualifier: biosynthesis, trimerization and lysyl oxidase crosslinking
name: Collagen biosynthesis, crosslinking and elastic fibre assembly
rationale: Members cover collagen synthesis, chain trimerization, oxidative crosslinking, anchoring fibrils, basement membrane and elastic fibres, whereas confusables emphasise integrin/fibronectin interactions, laminin or aortic elastin turnover.

qualifier: hyaloid vessel regression and retinal cell death
name: Postnatal eye maturation with hyaloid vessel regression
rationale: Members describe post-embryonic eye development including apoptotic regression of the hyaloid vasculature, retinal cell death and lens transparency, unlike confusables about embryonic eye and retinal morphogenesis.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA activation
name: cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA activation
rationale: Members cover adenylate cyclase regulation, cyclic nucleotide hydrolysis by PDE, PKA activation and cellular responses to cAMP/cGMP, distinguishing the theme from adrenergic-inhibitory, CREB/dopamine and PLC-coupled confusables.

qualifier: nucleotide excision, translesion and lagging-strand synthesis
name: UV-lesion excision repair, translesion and lagging-strand synthesis
rationale: Members cover nucleotide excision repair, translesion polymerases, polymerase switching and lagging/telomere C-strand synthesis, separating the theme from base excision, mismatch and alkylation repair confusables.

name: Retinoid metabolism, phototransduction and photoreceptor development
rationale: Members cover vitamin A/retinoic acid metabolism, the visual retinoid cycle, phototransduction and its diseases, and photoreceptor/retinal neuron development, while the confusables concern lens, cornea, iris and eye vasculature development.

name: Neutrophil extravasation and diapedesis
rationale: All members concern neutrophil migration across endothelium, distinct from leukocyte adhesion, formyl peptide chemotaxis and monocyte migration confusables.

name: Regulation of osteoblast differentiation and proliferation
rationale: All members regulate osteoblast differentiation or proliferation, unlike confusables about RUNX2-driven bone formation, osteoclasts or chondrocytes.

name: Diacylglycerol-derived endocannabinoid retrograde synaptic signaling
rationale: Members link DAG hydrolysis (yielding 2-AG) to endocannabinoid retrograde synaptic signaling, distinct from glycerolipid synthesis and neuropeptide signaling confusables.

name: Cold and diet-induced thermogenesis via fatty acid uncoupling
rationale: Members cover cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis with fatty acid transport, the fatty acid cycling uncoupling model and N-acyl amino acid uncouplers, unlike carnitine/beta-oxidation, glycerol transport and lipolysis confusables.

name: Checkpoint-coupled genome maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members combine intra-S checkpoint signaling, p53-driven repair gene transcription, DNA unwinding, break-induced replication and mitotic recombination resolution, distinguishing it from replication-initiation, fork-reversal and homologous recombination confusables.

qualifier: heme biosynthesis and transferrin/ferroportin iron transport
name: Heme biosynthesis and systemic iron transport
rationale: Members cover porphyrin/heme synthesis, heme scavenging and transport, transferrin uptake and ferroportin/ceruloplasmin iron export, unlike zinc/copper/cadmium metal confusables and the erythrocyte gas transport confusable.

qualifier: fibroblast fibronectin matrix and focal adhesion
name: Fibroblast fibronectin matrix and focal adhesion assembly
rationale: Members cover focal adhesion and integrin production, fibronectin matrix formation, fibroblast migration and TGF-beta/SRF cytoskeletal programs, versus confusables centred on MET/syndecan signaling or EMT/YAP stromal activation.

name: Inhibitory regulation of complement and antibody-mediated immunity
rationale: All members restrain complement (especially classical pathway) and immunoglobulin-mediated humoral responses, whereas every confusable concerns complement activation.

name: Mucin-type O-glycosylation and sialylated LacNAc chain extension
rationale: Members cover GALNT/C1GALT1C1-dependent O-GalNAc glycosylation, LacNAc antenna elongation and sialic acid capping, distinct from fucose/blood-group and early N-glycan processing confusables.

name: Methionine cycle and methylthioadenosine salvage
rationale: Members cover SAM synthesis, homocysteine remethylation (MTR/MTRR) and methionine salvage, distinguishing the theme from folate, selenium and choline/carnitine confusables.

name: Responses to UV, genotoxic drugs and oxidative stress
rationale: Members are responses to UV, DNA-damaging drugs, peroxides, phorbol ester and hypoxic/oxidative stress, unlike confusables about liver regeneration, ethanol/anesthetics or osmotic stress.

name: Renal urate and intestinal fructose transport
rationale: Members cover urate handling by SLC2A9/SLC22 transporters and fructose absorption and response, differing from cystine/organic cation and glucose/galactose transport confusables.

name: Autophagosome assembly and maturation in cargo-selective autophagy
rationale: Members regulate phagophore cargo recruitment, autophagosome assembly and maturation for mitophagy, pexophagy and xenophagy, versus confusables on PINK1-PRKN mitochondrial control, lysosome fusion or micro/chaperone-mediated autophagy.
